set(SPOTLIGHT_ICNS "")
if(APPLE)
    # packaging/macos/spotlight.icns is generated by packaging/macos/make-icns.sh
    set(SPOTLIGHT_ICNS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/packaging/macos/spotlight.icns)
    if(EXISTS ${SPOTLIGHT_ICNS})
        set_source_files_properties(${SPOTLIGHT_ICNS} PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION Resources)
    else()
        set(SPOTLIGHT_ICNS "")
    endif()
endif()

# The minimum macOS shown to Finder: the deployment target when set (the
# Intel build targets 12.0), else 11.0. The Apple Silicon build sets 14.0
# because Homebrew's Qt requires it.
if(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET)
    set(SPOTLIGHT_MACOS_MIN ${CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET})
else()
    set(SPOTLIGHT_MACOS_MIN 11.0)
endif()

qt_add_executable(spotlight MACOSX_BUNDLE main.cpp selftest.h selftest.cpp ${SPOTLIGHT_ICNS})
target_link_libraries(spotlight PRIVATE spotlight_ui)

set_target_properties(spotlight PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "$<IF:$<PLATFORM_ID:Darwin>,SPOTLIGHT,spotlight>"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/packaging/macos/Info.plist.in
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "com.spotlight.studio"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "SPOTLIGHT!"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE spotlight.icns
)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS spotlight
    BUNDLE DESTINATION .
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    install(FILES ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/packaging/linux/spotlight.desktop
            DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/applications)
    install(FILES ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/packaging/linux/spotlight.xml
            DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/mime/packages)
    install(FILES ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/icons/spotlight.svg
            DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps)
    install(FILES ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/icons/spotlight.png
            DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps)
endif()
